scenario: Community search over UGC posts, questions, answers, and comments. Primary metrics: relevance (nDCG) and click-through rate (CTR). Focus: semantic matching, query understanding, short-text retrieval, ranking, and LLM-assisted search.

papers.title: Grounded Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Search Agents
papers.authors: Qirui Liu, Hao Chen, Yi Wen, Weijie Shi, Yao Zhao, Xianhe Chen, Hao Zhao, Xing Tang, Weihong Luo, Yuyu Luo
papers.summary: A search agent can answer correctly without using retrieved evidence. Grounded Credit Assignment separates credit for finding evidence from credit for answering. On the larger evaluated model, it improves average exact match over Search-R1 by 6.3 percentage points.
papers.key_insight: Reward evidence acquisition separately from answer correctness. Otherwise, a lucky answer from memory credits the entire retrieval trace and can improve accuracy while weakening grounding. The proposed correction uses verifiable sub-outcomes without an extra reward model.

papers.title: MuninAI: A Self-Hosted Agentic Framework for Independent Research Groups
papers.authors: Markus Fischer, Jens Meiler, Matthias Elgeti
papers.summary: Munin indexes a local literature corpus and citation graph, then equips an open-weight model with reading, search, and computation tools. On paired literature questions, accuracy rises from 38.7% without the harness to 87.4% with it.
papers.key_insight: A fixed retrieve-then-answer pipeline underperforms the unaided model on every tested backbone. The useful unit is the whole reading harness, including citation tracing and abstention when evidence is missing. The released evaluation suite lets adopters test their own corpus.

papers.title: When Does Uncertainty Measure RAG Hallucination Risk?
papers.summary: Model confidence tracks unsupported answers only when retrieved evidence constrains the response. Across controlled unsupported edits, perplexity achieves AUROC between 0.81 and 0.91 after answer-length matching.
papers.key_insight: Interpret confidence together with retrieval coverage. Missing passages let the model answer confidently from parametric knowledge, changing what the score measures. The study finds that adding a second passage can restore discrimination lost with top-one retrieval.

papers.title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
papers.authors: Hyunseo Kim, Suil Choe, Sukkyoung So, Daeyeon Yi
papers.summary: GLOBE stores product-editing experience as explicit rules scoped to listing fields. Feedback updates the handbook, while moderation removes redundancy and deactivates harmful rules. Ranking-improvement success rises by 17.5 percentage points over prompt optimization.
papers.key_insight: An inspectable behavior handbook is easier to revise than a monolithic prompt. Field scope and outcome counts make rules reusable and removable. These are experimental ranker outcomes; shared models in the feedback loop can still introduce preference bias.

papers.title: SAFE-Mem: Secure Agentic Memory with Fine-Grained Authority and Governance-Aware Retrieval
papers.authors: Haoming Li, Dingyi Kang, Xu Hu, Jinxin Yang, Zhu Xu, Chenru Wang, Yi Ge, Miao Yin, Guanpeng Li, Feng Chen, Bingzhe Li
papers.summary: SAFE-Mem labels individual memory claims by kind, authority, and scope, then checks those permissions during retrieval. Attack success is at least 77% lower than the strongest evaluated defense that preserves legitimate memory use.
papers.key_insight: Remembering a statement does not authorize acting on it. Claim-level governance lets retrieval retain useful facts while blocking unauthorized influence. A provenance graph connects source sentences, claims, and entities for traceable decisions.

papers.summary: BRIA tests candidate tools in isolated branches and lets the task agent adopt only useful execution evidence. On MCP-Atlas, its average claim score exceeds MCP-Zero by 14.37 percentage points.
papers.key_insight: Keep failed tool investigations out of the main reasoning trajectory. Isolated trials preserve alternatives and let routing depend on execution evidence rather than tool descriptions alone. Evaluation uses a shared library of 1,897 tools.

papers.authors: Heming Zou, Qi Wang, Yixiu Mao, Yun Qu, Yuyi Guo, Zeyuan Liu, Chenglin Li, Weijie Liu, Saiyong Yang, Xiangyang Ji
papers.summary: TreeOPSD branches continuations from shared interaction prefixes, backs terminal rewards up the tree, and distills toward a bounded teacher distribution. It improves average Deep Research accuracy over GRPO by 4.97 percentage points on the reported model.

papers.authors: Yuhan Sun, Jiaxin Zhao, Yongdong Luo, Yibo Hu, Meiguang Jin, Junfeng Ma, Weixun Wang, Weihang Pan, Zhongan Bi

papers.authors: Mayank Arya, Agrim Bari, Anjaly Parayil, Yogesh Simmhan, Renee St. Amant, Victor R\"uhle, Saravan Rajmohan
